name: 🔥America PVP
desc:
💫 America PvP is a competitive fighting game inspired by FiveM, where you take on other players on a variety of immersive maps and scenarios.

🎯 We have a practical weapon system, fluid movement to make the gameplay even better.

🎮 Full support for all platforms:
PC 💻 | Mobile 📱 | Console 🎮

🎮 Controls:
Movement: WASD
Run: Shift
Jump: Space
Inventory: F
Items: 1, 2, 3

Tags: FiveM, RedM, RP, PVP, AmericaPvP, MTA
